transcript.en: Hi Jun.
transcript.zh: 你好 Jun。

transcript.en: As you know, I've asked you here today to discuss the future of our Self-Access Centre.
transcript.zh: 我今天找你来是想讨论自习室的未来，

transcript.en: We have to decide what we want to do about this very important resource for our English language students.
transcript.zh: 我们得决定如何处理这个对我们英语学生非常重要的资源。

transcript.en: So, can you tell me what the students think about this?
transcript.zh: 所以，你能告诉我学生们都是怎么想的吗？

transcript.en: Well, from the student's point of view, we would like to keep it.
transcript.zh: 从学生的角度看，我们需要保留它。

transcript.en: The majority of students say that they enjoy using it because it provides a variation on the classroom routine and they see it as a pretty major component of their course, but we would like to see some improvements to the equipment, particularly the computers; there aren't enough for one each at the moment and we always have to share.
transcript.zh: 大多数学生称自己很喜欢它，因为它为常规的课程带来了变化，他们认为这是课程的重要部分，但是我们希望设备能有所改进，特别是电脑。有时不能达到每个人使用一台，我们总是要和别人一起用。

transcript.en: Well yes, the teachers agree that it is a very valuable resource but one thing we have noticed is that a lot of the students are using it to check their personal emails. We don't want to stop you students using it, but we think the computers should be used as a learning resource, not for emails.
transcript.zh: 是的，老师们认为这是非常有价值的资源，但是我注意到一件事，许多学生用它查看个人邮件。我们不想阻止学生使用它，但是我们认为电脑应该当作一种学习资源，而不是查看电邮。

transcript.en: Some of us also think that we could benefit a lot more by relocating the Self-Access Centre to the main University library building.
transcript.zh: 我们中的一些人认为将自习室搬到大学图书馆会使人受益更多

transcript.en: How do you think the students would feel about that, Jun?
transcript.zh: 琼，你觉得学生们对此怎么看？

transcript.en: Well, the library is big enough to incorporate the Self-Access Centre, but it wouldn't be like a class activity anymore.
transcript.zh: 图书馆有足够的空间容纳自习室，但是这样就不再像课堂活动了。

transcript.en: Our main worry would be not being able to go to a teacher for advice.
transcript.zh: 我们主要的担心是这样就无法找老师寻求意见了

transcript.en: I'm sure there would be plenty of things to do but we really need teachers to help us choose the best activities.
transcript.zh: 我肯定那里会有很多事情要做，但是我们真的需要老师帮我们选择最佳的活动。

transcript.en: Well, there would still be a teacher present and he or she would guide the activities of the students, we wouldn't just leave them to get on with it.
transcript.zh: 那里仍然会有一位老师在场，他或她将指导学生的活动，我们不会置之不理。

transcript.en: Yes, but I think the students would be much happier keeping the existing set-up; they really like going to the Self-Access Centre with their teacher and staying together as a group to do activities.
transcript.zh: 是的，但是我认为学生们更希望保持现状，他们很喜欢和老师一起去自习室，一起做活动。

transcript.en: If we could just improve the resources and facilities, I think it would be fine.
transcript.zh: 如果我们可以只是改善资源和设施，我觉得就很好。

transcript.en: Is the cost going to be a problem?
transcript.zh: 经费是问题吗？

transcript.en: It's not so much the expense that I'm worried about, and we've certainly got room to do it, but it's the problem of timetabling a teacher to be in there outside class hours.
transcript.zh: 我担心的不是费用问题，而且我们也有地方，但是问题是在课外时间给老师排课。

transcript.en: If we're going to spend a lot of money on equipment and resources, we really need to make sure that everything is looked after properly.
transcript.zh: 如果我们要在设备和资源上花很多钱，我们真的要确保一切事情都能得到妥善处理。

transcript.en: Anyway, let's make some notes to see just what needs doing to improve the Centre.
transcript.zh: 总之，让我们记下笔记，看看改善中心需要做什么事。

transcript.en: Now, what about the computers?
transcript.zh: 现在，电脑怎么样？

transcript.en: I think it might be a good idea to install some new models.
transcript.zh: 我想装一些新型号是一个好主意。

transcript.en: They would take up a lot less room and so that would increase the work space for text books and so on.
transcript.zh: 它们占用的空间少，这样可以增加参考书等资源的运行空间。

transcript.en: That would be great.
transcript.zh: 太好了。

transcript.en: It is a bit cramped in there at times.
transcript.zh: 有时里面的地方是很小。

transcript.en: What about other resources?
transcript.zh: 其他资源怎么样

transcript.en: Do you have a list of things that the students would like to see improved?
transcript.zh: 你有学生们希望改进的单子目录吗？

transcript.en: Yes, one of the comments that students frequently make is that they find it difficult to find materials that are appropriate for their level, especially reading resources, so I think we need to label them more clearly.
transcript.zh: 是的。学生们经常说难以找到适合自己水平的材料，特别是读书资源，所以我想我们需要把它们标记得更清楚一些。

transcript.en: Well, that's easy enough, we can get that organized very quickly.
transcript.zh: 这很简单，我们可以很快弄好。

transcript.en: In fact I think we should review all of the study resources as some of them are looking a bit out-of-date.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我觉得我们应该检查一下所有的学习资源，因为有些资源已经有点过时了。

transcript.en: Definitely.
transcript.zh: 当然。

transcript.en: The CD section especially needs to be more current.
transcript.zh: 特别是光盘区需要更新

transcript.en: I think we should get some of the ones that go with our latest course books and also make multiple copies.
transcript.zh: 我认为我们应该引进一些与最新课本配套的资源，并且多留一些副本。

transcript.en: Good, now I was also thinking about some different materials that we haven't got in there at all.
transcript.zh: 很好。我还想到了一些我们这里没有的各种资源。

transcript.en: What do you think of the idea of introducing some workbooks?
transcript.zh: 你觉得引进一些练习册怎么样？

transcript.en: If we break them up into separate pages and laminate them, they'd be a great resource.
transcript.zh: 如果我们将它们拆分成单页，它们将是很好的资源。

transcript.en: The students could study the main course book in class and then do follow-up practice in the Self-Access Centre.
transcript.zh: 学生们可以在课堂上学习主要的教材知识，然后在自习室做后续的练习。

transcript.en: That sounds good.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: Okay, now finally we need to think about how the room is used.
transcript.zh: 好的，最后我们要想想怎么使用空间。

transcript.en: I'll have to talk to the teachers and make sure we can all reach some agreement on a timetable to supervise the centre after class.
transcript.zh: 我得跟老师们谈谈，确保在课后监督中心的时间上达成一致。

transcript.en: But we also need to think about security, too.
transcript.zh: 但是我们也要考虑安全问题。

transcript.en: Especially if we're going to invest in some new equipment.
transcript.zh: 特别是当我们对一些新设备投资时。

transcript.en: What about putting in an alarm?
transcript.zh: 装警报器怎么样？

transcript.en: Good idea.
transcript.zh: 好主意。

transcript.en: The other thing I'd like to do is talk to our technicians and see whether we could somehow limit the access to email.
transcript.zh: 我要做的另一件事是找到技术人员，看看能否减少电邮的使用。

transcript.en: I really don't want to see that resource misused.
transcript.zh: 我不想看到资源被滥用。

transcript.en: What about if we agree to only use it before and after class?
transcript.zh: 如果我们同意只在课前或课后用怎么样。

transcript.en: Yes, that would be fine.
transcript.zh: 好的，没问题。

transcript.en: OK, anyway... that's great for now.
transcript.zh: 总之目前还不错。

transcript.en: We'll discuss it further when we've managed to...
transcript.zh: 我们将进一步讨论，当……
